d:
Badli Si Chayi Hai from Ghar Jamai (1992) is a sweet, melodious and refreshing romantic song sung beautifully by Sadhana Sargam and Udit Narayan. Featuring Mithun Chakraborty and Varsha Usgaonkar, this track perfectly blends soft romance with a monsoon-like feel that touches the heart.
